spans.s: --also Vidarbha; the son of सैव्या and ज्यामघ after the former's severe austerities; married स्नुषा; got two sons and a third लोमपाद. वा. ९५. ३६.

(I)--a pupil of व्यास in charge of the यजुस्; was taught Nigada (Yajurveda). His pupils were Ca- रकाध्वर्युस्. याज्ञवल्क्य was one of the pupils; was also a पौराणिक.
1: भा.

. १३; ३३. 5; ३४. १३; ३५. 8-9, २०-22.
did not attend the Meru conference and ordered his pupils to take to Brahma विद्या.
3: वा. ६१. १४-16.
(II)--a sage who was invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठीर. भा. X. ७४. 8.
(III)--the sage who cursed king Jana- mejaya; questioned by शौनक for light on rituals condu- cive to realisation of one's desires. M. ५०. ५८; ९३. 1; वा. ९९. २५१.
--the kingdom to which Puramjana went with his companion Lubdhaka; allegorically Naraka. भा. IV. २५. ५३; २९. १५; V. २६. २५.
--the full moon day of the वैशाख month; good for gift of the ब्राह्म पुराण। M. ५३. १३.
--the १२थ् day of the bright half of वैशाख, the day on which उषा dreamt of her future husband. Vi. V. ३२. १४.
--one of the १३ wives of Vasudeva, the son of कौशिक. वा. ९६. १६०, १७२.
--a pupil of पराशर Kauthuma. Br. II. ३५. ४६.
(II)--one of Vasudeva's queens and mother of कौशिक. Br. III. ७१. १७४; Vi. IV. १५. २५.

--created from the thighs of ब्रह्मा; the less powerful, but are engaged in agriculture and commerce;
1: वा. ३०. २३२; ३४. १७; ४५. ८३ and ११७; ५४. १११; ५७. ५२; ७८. २९; ९३. ६६; १००. २४६; १०१. 5 and ३५२; १०४. १३; Vi.

, ३५.
for doing their svadharma they go to the abode of वायु.
2: Br.
--a pleasure garden to which Kardama and देवहूति went. भा. III. २३. ४०.
(I)--a ऋषिक and a king who became sage by satya. Br. II. ३२. १०२; M. १४५. ९६; वा. ५९. ९४.

(IV)--(Kubera: कुशरीरम् beram); the first son of विश्रवस् and देववर्णिनी; in form a राक्षस and in strength an Asura; description of; three feet, big head, eight teeth, yellow moustache, ears like शन्कु, short hands; full of the knowledge of Vaivarta; and in the guise of विश्व- रूप or various forms;
1: वा. ७०. ३५-40; Vi. I. २२. 3.
the king of यक्षस्.
2: वा. ३०. ८४-5; ४१. २६; ६२. १८२; ७०. 7.
(I)--Agni also known as ब्राह्मण chamsi. Br. II. १२. २९; वा. ६२. १३७.
--the eighth day in the dark half of माघ. वा. ८१. 3.

. २४.
to be propitiated by eight oblations or वैश्वदेव and five others. प्राण, अपान, समान, उदान and व्यान।
2: वा. १
(II)--a son of Danu, and father of four daughters, उपदानवी and others. भा.
(III)--father of two daughters, पुलोमा and काल (li) का who were married to मारिच; from them ७४,000 दानवस्; lived in हिरण्यपुर; slain by Arjuna.
(V)--a son of भरताग्नि. वा. २९. 8; Br. II. १२. 8.
--the दक्षिणस्थानम्, which has three roads or वीथिस्. Br.
--leads to the world of ब्रह्मा. M. १०१. ५७.
(III)--in दक्षिण ma1rga; मूलम् and पूर्वोत्तराषाढस् are the नक्षत्रस्. M. १२४. ५९; वा. ६६. ५२. [page३-344+ ३१]

. २९.
day and night equal; this विषुवम् takes place during the spring and autumn when the sun enters the signs of Aries (तुलाम्) and Libra (मेष).
2: Ib.
--the place of अन्गारि Agni. Br. II. १२. ३०.
(I)--the पुराण of २३,000 श्लोकस् compiled by पराशर; he who copies this and makes a gift of it on the आषाढ full moon day reaches the world of वरुण; gives an account of वराह kalpa. M. ५३. १६-17.

a mind-born mother;

makes the sun shine radiant.

(II)--a goddess among the मातृस्; Icon of, after the manner of विष्णु; गरुड is the riding animal; four hands in the वरद पोसे। M. १३. ५२; २६१. २८.
